examples: Ask the author a question under their skill, or report a comment that breaks the rules.
how_to: Open a skill in the catalog and scroll to comments. Post, reply once deep, edit within 15 minutes, delete or report. Press a handle to open the author's page. Turn reply emails on or off in the catalog account panel.
media_exempt: comments need a signed-in catalog account, which a capture must not use
name: Comments and author pages
summary: comment on a catalog skill or theme, report abuse, and open an author's page from any handle.
where: A skill's detail pane in the catalog, and a theme's feedback block on the themes page.
